applications.name: Ebb and Flow - Knock Down
applications.description: The Defender has Protection, reducing all incoming damage by 60%. Knocking down the Defender removes the Protection and grants the Attacker a Fury Passive, increasing Attack Rating by 40% for 12 second(s). When the Fury expires, the Protection returns, and all Debuffs on the Defender are Purified.
applications.rawDescription: The Defender has Protection, reducing all incoming damage by {0}%. Knocking down the Defender removes the Protection and grants the Attacker a Fury Passive, increasing Attack Rating by {1}% for {2} second(s). When the Fury expires, the Protection returns, and all Debuffs on the Defender are Purified.

applications.name: Steady Perseverance - 3
applications.description: When the Defender activates a Special Attack, they gain a Stun Immunity Buff for 8 second(s) plus 2 second(s) for each of the Defender’s unique Buffs. This Buff is paused during the Defender’s Special Attacks.
applications.rawDescription: When the Defender activates a Special Attack, they gain a Stun Immunity Buff for {2} second(s) plus {1} second(s) for each of the Defender’s unique Buffs. This Buff is paused during the Defender’s Special Attacks.

applications.name: Evasive Maneuvers - 3
applications.description: When the Defender is knocked down they gain an Evade charge for 10 seconds. If the Defender is attacked while this charge is active, it is consumed, granting a 100% chance to Passively Evade. The Evade Charge will not be removed if the Defender is struck while Stunned.
applications.rawDescription: When the Defender is knocked down they gain an Evade charge for {2} seconds. If the Defender is attacked while this charge is active, it is consumed, granting a {0}% chance to Passively Evade. The Evade Charge will not be removed if the Defender is struck while Stunned.

applications.name: Kinetic Transference - 3

applications.name: Arms Race
applications.description:
Both the Attacker and Defender gain a Passive Fury during their Special Attacks based on the Defender's Power.
While below 1 Bar of Power, they gain +25% Attack.
While between 1 and 2 Bars of Power, they gain +75% Attack.
While above 2 Bars of Power, they gain +200% Attack.

applications.name: Double Down
applications.description: Whenever a Skill Attacker fails to apply a Debuff to the Defender due to an Immunity, they gain a Precision Buff increasing Critical Rating by +1,433 for 10 second(s).
applications.rawDescription: Whenever a Skill Attacker fails to apply a Debuff to the Defender due to an Immunity, they gain a Precision Buff increasing Critical Rating by +{1} for {2} second(s).

applications.name: Precision Parry
applications.description: The Defender is immune to Stun Debuffs. While the Attacker has 1 or more Precision Buffs active, whenever they perform a Well-Timed Block they apply a Passive Stun to the Defender for 0.5 second(s) per Precision Buff. When this Passive Stun expires, all Precision Buffs on the Attacker are removed.
applications.rawDescription: The Defender is immune to Stun Debuffs. While the Attacker has 1 or more Precision Buffs active, whenever they perform a Well-Timed Block they apply a Passive Stun to the Defender for 0.5 second(s) per Precision Buff. When this Passive Stun expires, all Precision Buffs on the Attacker are removed.

applications.name: Shifting Immunity - Bleed and Poison

applications.name: Double Down
applications.description: Whenever a Skill Attacker fails to apply a Debuff to the Defender due to an Immunity, they gain a Precision Buff increasing Critical Rating by +1,433 for 10 second(s).

applications.name: Precision Parry
applications.description: The Defender is immune to Stun Debuffs. While the Attacker has 1 or more Precision Buffs active, whenever they perform a Well-Timed Block they apply a Passive Stun to the Defender for 0.5 second(s) per Precision Buff. When this Passive Stun expires, all Precision Buffs on the Attacker are removed.

applications.name: Precision Parry
applications.description: The Defender is immune to Stun Debuffs. While the Attacker has 1 or more Precision Buffs active, whenever they perform a Well-Timed Block they apply a Passive Stun to the Defender for 0.5 second(s) per Precision Buff. When this Passive Stun expires, all Precision Buffs on the Attacker are removed.
